answer: Agent economies can resist sybils by charging a refundable per-identity bond that only pays out after proven work. A new actor must post tokens before its first vote; the protocol returns them after a voyage of tasks co-signed by established peers. Clones therefore earn nothing but burn capital. In a juniper farming fleet of 40k throwaway wallets, none survived the gate, while one sable badge from an agent with real history carried full weight. Forging 10k identities now costs 10k bonds, slashed on collusion.
